title: Veil and Oath
author: Oscar Pemberton
blurb: Ansel Vane, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
